'''Hebsly''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], who served in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] before being assigned to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. He was present aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] made his unexpected visit to the battle station. He later used the excellent maneuverability of his [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], [[Scythe 3]], in combat during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle of Endor]].
